queries.q: when must replacement property be identified in a like-kind exchange
queries.expect: ends at midnight on the 45th day thereafter

queries.q: what factors indicate an activity is engaged in for profit
queries.expect: in a businesslike manner and maintains complete and accurate books and records

queries.q: how is the kiddie tax computed for a child's unearned income
queries.expect: reduced by the child's net unearned income, plus the child's share of the allocable parental tax

queries.q: when is a stock loss disallowed as a wash sale
queries.expect: from the sale or other disposition of stock or securities

queries.q: what is the required annual estimated tax installment computed from
queries.expect: An amount equal to 90 percent of the tax computed, at the rates applicable to the taxable year
